$comment: Licences a shipped dependency may have, as SPDX identifiers, because they may be combined with AGPL-3.0-only (#370). `pnpm licences` fails on any other, on an unknown one and on a free-text licence. Not here on purpose: GPL-2.0-only and LGPL-2.0-only (incompatible with GPL-3.0), SSPL, BUSL, Commons Clause and non-commercial or no-derivatives licences. `allowedExceptions` are the SPDX exceptions a `WITH` may add (they only grant more); any other, such as Commons-Clause, is refused. A dependency whose licence was reviewed and found acceptable all the same goes into `exceptions`: the package, its licence exactly as `pnpm licenses list` reports it, and why. Platform builds are matched by their name without the platform words (`@img/sharp-libvips`).
